statements.status_notes: GHSA-vh4v-2xq2-g5cg (GO-2026-5884, no CVE id): ORAS Go before 2.6.1 could send the Authorization header it used for one registry to a different origin when a registry redirected a manifest request or returned an upload Location on another host or port (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vh4v-2xq2-g5cg, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5884). The fix is https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/commit/3c2e884e12ea52b6bff60c97f1edb7df7d0e0909, first released in https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/releases/tag/v2.6.1; v2.6.2 contains it too. Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each holds one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 for GOOS=linux. The -dev build has the same Go release and module versions as the scout-cli build of the same version, built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath. We downloaded all 50 of these packages (each matching its index checksum) and read the Go build information (go version -m) and the function table (go tool nm) of every program. The ORAS Go version is oras.land/oras-go/v2 v2.6.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0; oras.land/oras-go/v2 v2.6.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, and every build links its registry client (oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote). No build ships v2.6.0 together with a backport, and no build ships v2.6.1. So every build before 1.23.1-r1 is affected and 1.23.1-r1 is the first build that ships a fixed ORAS Go release; the range follows the module version each build ships.

For every build that file has the same md5 as /usr/bin/docker-scout in the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli package of the same version and architecture (1.20.4-r1 for 1.20.4-1, and so on), so it is the same program; we downloaded every one of those Alpine packages (each matching its index checksum) and read the Go build information (go version -m) and the function table (go tool nm) of every program. The ORAS Go version is oras.land/oras-go/v2 v2.6.0 in 1.20.4-1 to 1.23.1-0; oras.land/oras-go/v2 v2.6.2 in 1.23.1-1 to 1.30.0-1, and every build links its registry client (oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote). No build ships v2.6.0 together with a backport, and no build ships v2.6.1. So every build before 1.23.1-1 is affected and 1.23.1-1 is the first build that ships a fixed ORAS Go release; the range follows the module version each build ships.

GHSA-vh4v-2xq2-g5cg (GO-2026-5884, no CVE id): ORAS Go before 2.6.1 could send the Authorization header it used for one registry to a different origin when a registry redirected a manifest request or returned an upload Location on another host or port (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vh4v-2xq2-g5cg, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5884). The fix is https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/commit/3c2e884e12ea52b6bff60c97f1edb7df7d0e0909, first released in https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/releases/tag/v2.6.1; v2.6.2 contains it too.
